description: Tell a joke at another Sim. Prerequisite: target Sim is present on the lot and their current pie menu exposes a 'Tell Joke' (or joke-family) entry — resolved live by the bot against the target's VM-side TTAB check. Effect: queues the Tell Joke interaction on your action queue; on success produces laughter/reaction animations on both Sims and shifts the target's relationship-to-you along the fun/friendship axis (TTAB-driven; visible in nearby_sims.relationship). Cost: ~ a minute of in-sim time; queue slot consumed; may fail server-side Verify if the target disallows (e.g. sleeping, incompatible mood).

args.name: target_sim_id
args.description: Persist ID of the target Sim.

args.name: target_object_id
args.description: Local ObjectID of the target Sim.
